title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The faerie queen, an avatar of Oona in the shape of Maralen of the Mornsong, who flees Rhys and seeks Ashling's help.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin Strixhaven student of the Prismari study track who blows up a flower bud to escape and befriends the boggarts.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon student who presses Maralen on her promises and her guilt over Oona.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A hunter and tracker bound to kill Maralen if Oona returns, who pursues the fleeing group.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The old faerie queen who made Maralen and her brother, braided the auroras into a single great aurora, and murdered a giant before her son's eyes.

entities.name: Maralen of the Mornsong
entities.description: The elf whose shed skin Oona slipped her avatar Maralen into.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A black-glass flamekin of Mount Tanufel who is an old friend and sometimes enemy of Maralen and becomes rimekin by night.

entities.name: Stinkdrinker Warren
entities.description: A warren of friendly, colorful boggarts in a swamp on the Wanderwine who host Maralen and lend a boat.

entities.name: Mount Tanufel
entities.description: The mountain from which the Wanderwine springs, home to Ashling's flamekin.

entities.name: Wanderwine
entities.description: The river that the group travels, now cut by a line of night.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's palace, which she has fled.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: The forest containing the waterfall and a grove Isilu has taken, where dawnglove grows.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: The transformed Shadowmoor village toward which the group travels.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A white-furred lion-man planeswalker who searches the dolmen gate area and rescues Kirol from Morcant.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire student forced by Morcant to gather dawnglove from a night-claimed grove.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf hunter who refuses to send Kirol back to die and defects with Ajani and Kirol.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The High Perfect of the elves who seeks poisons to kill Isilu and coerces Kirol to retrieve dawnglove.

entities.name: Dawnglove
entities.description: A glowing flower from Shadowmoor from which the elves distill a potion they intend to use against Isilu.

entities.name: Cinders
entities.description: Smoldering humanoids of Shadowmoor that chase Kirol in the dark grove.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: The kithkin hero, transformed into her moon-eyed Shadowmoor self, who leads the party that captures Maralen's group.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon-headed incarnation walking serenely across Shadowmoor-claimed land, followed by a small green faerie.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The sun incarnation, a balancing force to Isilu.

entities.name: Blue faerie
entities.description: The faerie that lured the students; it flickers between blue and green and is revealed to be Maralen's brother in his Shadowmoor form.

entities.name: Maralen's brother
entities.description: Oona's first avatar, meant to be Shadowmoor's prince, who defied her and vanished into the green after she had a giant he called father killed.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Empire
entities.description: The elvish realm whose leaders plan to kill Isilu.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Oona's braided aurora that locked the plane in one state for centuries.

events.summary: Maralen, Sanar and Tam escape the palace by blowing the bud off a giant stem with Sanar's improvised explosive and sliding down it.
events.quote: The bud exploded, sending sticky chunks flying in all directions.

events.summary: Maralen finds a hidden coracle and the trio drifts toward the Wanderwine; Maralen explains Oona was her creator and she must prove she is not her.
events.quote: But I'm still myself.

events.summary: Maralen explains she keeps Rhys alive by magic through their binding promise.
events.quote: As long as he's bound to me, my magic keeps him alive.

events.summary: The coracle reaches the Stinkdrinker Warren, where Ashling pulls Maralen ashore.
events.quote: A four-fingered hand made of what looked like flexible black glass caught her wrist and tugged her onto solid ground.

events.summary: Maralen tells Ashling their story, and Ashling reveals the elves and Morcant plan to kill the night beast with poisons.
events.quote: They're concocting a plan to kill the creature.

events.summary: Maralen rejects ending the night forever, saying eternal day is Oona's way, and Ashling agrees to help stop the elves.
events.quote: Eternal day is Oona's way, not my own.

events.summary: The blue-and-green faerie eavesdrops on the conversation and flies off.
events.quote: It flicked back and forth between blue and green

events.summary: Ajani arrives near the dolmen gate, fights a Shadowmoor serpent and finds the students' footprints leading away.
events.quote: until he finally had no choice but to strike it down.

events.summary: Ajani fights a boar and senses how out of sync and unhappy the plane is.
events.quote: Beasts of Shadowmoor and beasts of Lorwyn, both driven to attack by the sudden change of day into night.

events.summary: Maralen, Tam, Sanar and Ashling set out down the Wanderwine in a boggart-crewed boat, and Maralen tells of Oona's great aurora.
events.quote: she managed to capture the auroras that naturally flare between night and day and braid them into a single great aurora

events.summary: Maralen reveals she was made by Oona as a weapon-avatar and slipped into the skin of Maralen of the Mornsong.
events.quote: I was to be her avatar, a part of her, carrying her consciousness ahead of my own.

events.summary: Maralen tells of her older brother, Oona's first avatar, who defied her, befriended a giant he called father, and vanished after Oona had the giant killed.
events.quote: The first was my brother.

events.summary: Shadowmoor claims the Wanderwine and the boggarts refuse to go farther, forcing the group to walk.
events.quote: Shadowmoor had taken the Wanderwine.

events.summary: Morcant and Lluwen force Kirol, bound, toward a grove claimed by Isilu to gather dawnglove.
events.quote: You're going to go inside and gather them for us.

events.summary: Kirol finds the dawnglove flowers and is chased by cinders but escapes with a sprig.
events.quote: they burst through the veil of rainbows with the dawnglove in their hand

events.summary: Morcant orders Kirol back for more dawnglove; Kirol and Lluwen refuse.
events.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.

events.summary: Ajani bursts in, drives back the cinders and defies Morcant, then takes Kirol away.
events.quote: My name is Ajani, and we are leaving.

events.summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.
events.quote: Lluwen had an instant to make up his mind.

events.summary: Ashling steps into Shadowmoor and becomes rimekin, retaining her memory.
events.quote: By night, I'm what we call 'rimekin,'

events.summary: The transformed kithkin of Goldmeadow led by Brigid surround and herd the party.
events.quote: the transformed Brigid at the front of their pack.

events.summary: Isilu approaches with a small green faerie flitting before it, and Maralen recognizes it as her brother.
events.quote: My brother,

events.summary: A line of elf torches appears while Isilu closes in, and the kithkin ready to fight.
events.quote: And all the while, Isilu came closer, the living night descending on the drowning dregs of day.

relations.note: She made Maralen as an avatar.
relations.quote: She pinched off a piece of herself, like plucking a petal from a flower, and she made me.
she made another before me, intended to be Shadowmoor's prince in waiting.

relations.note: He is Maralen's older brother, made from the other half of the same petal.
relations.quote: I remember my older brother fighting her so hard I thought the palace might fall.

relations.note: Old friends who have also been enemies.
relations.quote: We've been enemies as often as we've been friends

relations.note: Bound by promise to kill her, he hunts her.
She is a flamekin of Mount Tanufel.
relations.quote: She's one of the flamekin of Mount Tanufel, from which the Wanderwine River springs.

relations.note: Her elves seek poisons to kill the night beast.
relations.quote: They're seeking poisons that might allow them to complete the task.

relations.note: Lluwen refuses to let Kirol die and follows them.
relations.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.
Are you one of Professor Vess's missing students?

relations.note: Her night self leads the kithkin who surround Maralen's party.
relations.quote: spears and knives in their hands, the transformed Brigid at the front of their pack.

relations.note: Maralen says she has friends in this bog and the boggarts lend a boat.
relations.quote: I have friends in this bog.
